text:
Matt Boldy has a hat trick in Toronto again, the kind of thing that makes headlines ("Joins Exclusive Company," as NDTV Sports put it), and two more goals and an assist against Nashville on Tuesday. He has 12 goals and 24 points in 23 games for a Wild team with points in 12 straight.

His goals are clean. Twelve on 12.2 expected means he is scoring exactly what his shots deserve, and the shots are plentiful: 94 on goal, 1.49 expected goals per 60, a top-10% shot speed. The points are a little padded. Minnesota has scored 7.2 more goals than the chances deserved with him on the ice, so his assists are getting help.

Last season Evolving-Hockey had him 32nd among 401 forwards at 2.5 wins above replacement, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 84th percentile for chances from the slot area. Watch him in front: that's where the goals come from, and that part should hold up. Our range has him finishing around 42 goals.
